modules.name: Visitor Management
modules.description: Handles walk-in visitors, their entry and exit records, and who may view visitor records.

rules.title: Walk-in visitor entry and exit by one role
rules.description: Only the last role column in the table (the one with Yes) may add a walk-in visitor and record entry and exit; all other roles have No.

rules.title: Visitor record view access varies by role
rules.description: Viewing a visitor record is limited per role: one role has View, one has Yes, one sees Own visitors only, one has No, and the last role sees Today only.

rules.title: Only one role can override stuck approval or check
rules.description: Overriding a stuck approval or check is allowed for only the first role column (Yes); all other roles have No.
